description.p: Lightmorphic Browser is a privacy-first browser built on Chromium. Sync is end-to-end encrypted — your data is encrypted before it ever leaves your device, so even a compromised sync server can't read it. Self-host your own sync server or use ours. A sidebar panel (notes, pinned pages, bookmarks) and a right-click quick-paste tool for snippets and clipboard history round it out. Extension installs are proxied rather than talking to Google directly.
